course.title: Personal Health, Wellbeing & Resilience
course.safety_boundary: Educational only. Does not qualify a learner to diagnose, treat, prescribe, provide clinical counseling, or practice a regulated health profession.

modules.title: Health Literacy & Scope
modules.essential: How to find, interpret and use health information without overstepping personal or professional limits.

lessons.title: Health Information Versus Medical Advice
lessons.focus: Distinguish general education from diagnosis, treatment and individualized clinical advice.

lessons.title: Trusted Sources and Red Flags
lessons.focus: Evaluate public-health, clinical and commercial health information.

lessons.title: When to Seek Professional Help
lessons.focus: Recognize situations that require qualified medical, mental-health or emergency support.

modules.title: Sleep, Recovery & Daily Rhythms
modules.essential: How sleep and recovery support attention, mood, learning and physical wellbeing.

lessons.title: Sleep Need and Consistency
lessons.focus: Understand regular sleep timing and adequate rest.

lessons.title: Sleep Environment and Habits
lessons.focus: Identify behaviors and environments that support better sleep.

lessons.title: Fatigue, Safety and Help-Seeking
lessons.focus: Recognize when persistent fatigue or sleep problems warrant professional evaluation.

modules.title: Nutrition & Hydration Basics
modules.essential: How everyday food and hydration choices support health without fad claims.

lessons.title: Balanced Eating Patterns
lessons.focus: Use broad food-group and nutrient principles rather than restrictive fad rules.

lessons.title: Hydration and Context
lessons.focus: Adjust hydration awareness for activity, environment and individual needs.

lessons.title: Reading Food Claims and Labels
lessons.focus: Interpret labels and marketing without treating a single nutrient as the whole diet.

modules.title: Movement & Physical Activity
modules.essential: How regular activity supports health while respecting ability and safety.

lessons.title: Activity, Mobility and Daily Movement
lessons.focus: Build regular movement appropriate to ability and context.

lessons.title: Strength, Endurance and Recovery
lessons.focus: Understand broad training categories and recovery needs.

lessons.title: Injury Prevention and Warning Signs
lessons.focus: Recognize when pain, injury or symptoms require rest or professional evaluation.

modules.title: Stress, Emotion & Regulation
modules.essential: How stress responses affect functioning and how healthy coping supports resilience.

lessons.title: Stress Response and Load
lessons.focus: Distinguish short-term stress from sustained overload.

lessons.title: Grounding, Breathing and Recovery Practices
lessons.focus: Use low-risk self-regulation strategies for everyday stress.

lessons.title: When Coping Is Not Enough
lessons.focus: Recognize signs that professional mental-health support may be needed.

modules.title: Mental Health Literacy
modules.essential: How to discuss mental health without stigma or amateur diagnosis.

lessons.title: Mood, Anxiety and Functioning
lessons.focus: Describe common experiences without labeling oneself or others with diagnoses.

lessons.title: Support Networks and Trusted Help
lessons.focus: Identify appropriate personal, school, community and clinical support.

lessons.title: Crisis Recognition and Emergency Help
lessons.focus: Know that immediate danger, self-harm risk or severe crisis requires urgent qualified help.

modules.title: First Aid Awareness & Emergency Readiness
modules.essential: How to prepare for common emergencies without misrepresenting training or certification.

lessons.title: Emergency Action Priorities
lessons.focus: Recognize scene safety, emergency contact and basic response priorities.

lessons.title: First Aid Scope and Certification Boundaries
lessons.focus: Distinguish awareness education from certified first-aid or CPR training.

lessons.title: Emergency Plans and Supplies
lessons.focus: Build household or personal readiness plans appropriate to local risks.

modules.title: Preventive Health & Routine Care
modules.essential: How screening, vaccination, hygiene and routine care reduce risk.

lessons.title: Preventive Care and Screening Concepts
lessons.focus: Understand why screening depends on age, risk and professional guidance.

lessons.title: Hygiene and Infection Prevention
lessons.focus: Use basic hand, food, respiratory and environmental hygiene principles.

lessons.title: Vaccination and Public-Health Information
lessons.focus: Evaluate vaccine information using qualified public-health and clinical sources.

modules.title: Substances, Medications & Safety
modules.essential: How to reduce harm around alcohol, drugs and medicines without prescribing.

lessons.title: Medication Labels and Safe Use
lessons.focus: Follow labels and professional instructions; avoid sharing or improvising medication use.

lessons.title: Alcohol, Nicotine and Other Substances
lessons.focus: Understand broad health and safety risks without normalizing misuse.

lessons.title: Interactions, Impairment and Help-Seeking
lessons.focus: Recognize when substance use or medication effects create safety concerns requiring help.

modules.title: Relationships, Boundaries & Communication
modules.essential: How healthy communication and boundaries support wellbeing.

lessons.title: Consent, Boundaries and Respect
lessons.focus: Recognize voluntary agreement, personal boundaries and the right to withdraw consent.

lessons.title: Conflict, Communication and Repair
lessons.focus: Use respectful communication and de-escalation in ordinary disagreements.

lessons.title: Unsafe or Controlling Dynamics
lessons.focus: Recognize warning signs and seek trusted support when relationships feel unsafe.

modules.title: Health Claims, Traditional Practices & Evidence
modules.essential: How to evaluate wellness and traditional-health claims respectfully and safely.

lessons.title: Tradition, Culture and Health Practice
lessons.focus: Study traditional practices in historical and cultural context without assuming efficacy.

lessons.title: Evidence, Risk and Plausibility
lessons.focus: Ask what evidence exists, what risks are known and what uncertainty remains.

lessons.title: Supplements, Remedies and Professional Guidance
lessons.focus: Avoid assuming natural means safe; seek qualified advice for interactions or medical use.

modules.title: Personal Wellbeing & Resilience Plan
modules.essential: How to synthesize safe health habits, support systems and emergency plans.

lessons.title: Personal Wellbeing Inventory
lessons.focus: Assess routines, supports, risks and realistic improvement goals.

lessons.title: Resilience and Help Network Plan
lessons.focus: Document trusted contacts, services and coping resources.

lessons.title: Capstone Health Literacy Portfolio
lessons.focus: Present an evidence-based wellbeing plan with clear safety and professional-scope boundaries.

assessment.capstone: personal wellbeing/resilience portfolio + source-quality review + safety/scope statement
